scope: Four sequential fresh clean-Python children invoking the genuine uninstrumented TennisEventDetector._features, synthetic inputs only; no models, inference, video, full event pipeline, full-match capacity or scientific accuracy claim.
fixture: Every TemporalBallPoint and feature position is generated by helper.fixture: native synthetic index/60 timestamp, fixed 1920x1080 image dimensions, smooth sinusoidal positions, all five nonmissing states plus explicit missing/partial coordinate gaps, null/zero/measured confidence; physical coordinates unavailable. Full input bytes and settings must match old/current.
method: Exactly one unmodified _features call per child after inputs are ready; one perf_counter span, no profiler/counter/patch/global JSON replacement. Frozen/current event class loads via same module alias; actual ordinary project dependencies are shared unchanged and source-bound.
featureOutput: Complete dataclasses.asdict(feature) records emitted one at a time as a JSON array in original field/key order using stdlib json.dump default separators/ensure_ascii and allow_nan=True; every field retained, no rounding or volatile exclusions. All records validate frame and index/60 timestamp. Whole output byte comparison uses bounded 64KiB file reads.
sourceBindings: Freeze preparation helper/protocol/baseline receipt/frozen+current event/dependency sources, monitor and clean/base interpreters. Verify before launch, within child before/after work and at terminal. Child additionally hashes every actual imported Python/extension file (including ordinary external library/stdlib dependencies) before and after the actual computation; parent rechecks them. No irrelevant model assets.
processOwnership: Reuse current hardened scripts/audit/measure_candidate_storage.py OwnedProcessTree and stop_owned. Exact actual interpreter PID/createTime is atomically published and parent sampled/acknowledged before heavy imports; original clean-env Windows redirector is also owned. Parent samples the entire remembered descendant tree; guard failure stops only exact owned descendants deepest-first with original Popen handle fallback; bounded retirement check required on normal and error exits.
handshakeOrder: Parent owned.sample happens before exact observed_workload check and atomic acknowledgment. JSONL sample timestamp is assigned after acknowledgment, so timestamp<=ack is deliberately not asserted. Child waits at most ten seconds for matching acknowledgment before imports.
retention: One exclusive run directory/launch marker; new case directories and files created exclusively. Preserve first declined/failed case, logs, samples and partial outputs; halt all later cases, no retry, no recursive cleanup, no existing artifact replacement. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE behavior prevents import artifacts outside measurement.
timingScope: Feature compute seconds separately from imports/input generation+serialization, full feature serialization, output hash verification, child elapsed and parent monitor wall. No repeated trials or speed threshold. Any current timing is observed only after terminal pass.
memoryScope: Actual workload interpreter OS peak working set and pagefile/private commit separate from sampled aggregate owned RSS/private; sampling can miss spikes and shared pages can be double-counted. Guarded low host RAM can include unrelated processes.

firstConsumedMeasurement.retention: All first measurement files must retain exact inventory/bytes/hashes before child work and at terminal; every first owned PID/createTime identity must be retired now. No first file is reused, changed or removed.

conditionalFreshLaunch: Root reviews and explicitly dispatches this separate exclusive unit only after actual RAM headroom clears the same 750 MB preflight. No automatic retries or guard relaxation. Previous public runtime was independently observed absent, ten job rows and319 saved files preserved; preparation does not stop/start runtime or free host RAM.
